kpis.title: Total Foreign Visitors
kpis.sql: SELECT sum(jumlah) AS v FROM serving.mart_wisman
kpis.caption: foreign visits (cumulative)

kpis.title: Tracked Destinations
kpis.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT destinasi) AS v FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw
kpis.caption: tourist attractions (DTW)

kpis.title: Events (Latest Year)
kpis.sql: SELECT jumlah_event AS v, tahun FROM serving.mart_event ORDER BY tahun DESC LIMIT 1
kpis.caption: number of events in the latest year

kpis.title: GCI Indicators Ready
kpis.sql: SELECT sum(data_tersedia) AS v, count() AS total FROM serving.mart_gci_readiness
kpis.caption: indicators with data available

charts.title: Foreign Visitor Trend
charts.subtitle: Monthly total across years
charts.sql:
SELECT concat(toString(tahun),'-',leftPad(toString(bulan_no),2,'0')) AS periode,
                 round(sum(jumlah)) AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_wisman
          GROUP BY tahun, bulan_no
          ORDER BY tahun, bulan_no

charts.title: Top Source Countries
charts.subtitle: Top 10 nationalities
charts.sql:
SELECT negara, round(sum(jumlah)) AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_wisman
          GROUP BY negara ORDER BY jumlah DESC LIMIT 10

charts.title: Visitors by Region
charts.subtitle: Distribution by continent/region
charts.sql:
SELECT kawasan, round(sum(jumlah)) AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_wisman
          GROUP BY kawasan ORDER BY jumlah DESC

charts.title: Visitors by Entry Point
charts.subtitle: Arrival points
charts.sql:
SELECT pintu_masuk, round(sum(jumlah)) AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_wisman
          GROUP BY pintu_masuk ORDER BY jumlah DESC

charts.title: Visits by Destination
charts.subtitle: Domestic vs foreign, top 8 destinations
charts.sql:
SELECT destinasi, round(sum(wisnus)) AS wisnus, round(sum(wisman)) AS wisman
          FROM serving.mart_kunjungan_dtw
          GROUP BY destinasi ORDER BY sum(total) DESC LIMIT 8

charts.title: Event Count Trend
charts.subtitle: Per year
charts.sql:
SELECT toString(tahun) AS tahun, jumlah_event AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_event ORDER BY tahun

charts.title: GCI Data Readiness
charts.subtitle: Readiness status distribution
charts.sql:
SELECT readiness, count() AS n
          FROM serving.mart_gci_readiness
          GROUP BY readiness ORDER BY n DESC

charts.title: Culinary Businesses by Area
charts.subtitle: Registered businesses
charts.sql:
SELECT wilayah, sum(jumlah_usaha) AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_kuliner
          GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY jumlah DESC

charts.title: Tourism POIs by Category
charts.subtitle: Number of POIs
charts.sql:
SELECT kategori, jumlah_poi AS jumlah
          FROM serving.mart_atlas ORDER BY jumlah_poi DESC
